featured_reviews.name: Shashank Shekhar
featured_reviews.review_text: यहां पर बाइक मोडिफिकेशन की जानकारी नहीं है तो पर v वे हां बोल देते हैं और उसके बाद पार्ट्स को खोलकर वापस से कसना पड़ता है, मै यहां अपने बाइक में क्रैश गार्ड, फुट रेस्ट और saddle stay ke liye gya the, उन्होंने क्रैश गार्ड सही से लगाया, लेकिन footrest को इतना वाहियात और बिना लॉजिक और ज्ञान के कसा कि इतना जोर से आवाज आए बाइक से झटका लगे कि शायद मुझे लगा कुछ टूट गया हो, लेकिन बाद में मैने यूट्यूब से समझा उन्होंने क्या किया एक तरफ का nut soccer wala jo बाहर parts आता है उसमें कसा और एक nut को saree गार्ड me kasa jisse soccer jab bike चलते समय नीचे जाए तो दोनों में खिंचाव पैदा हो और पूरी बाइक imbalance हो जाए और खट खट की आवाज आए और पार्ट्स v थोड़ा टेढ़ा हुआ, जब मैने दूसरी बार saddle stay लगवाने gya, to bina जानकारी के उसने हां कहकर पार्ट्स खोल दिया, फिर वापस से उसने कसा तो इतना ज्यादा ओवरटाइट कर दिया nut को टेढ़ा रखके बिना बासर के जिससे टेढ़ा हुआ, जैसे लग रहा हो स्टाफ काम नहीं कर रहा हो वो भड़ास निकाल रहा हो, और जब शुरू में खोलना था तब उसने टाइट कर रहा था जैसे कस्टमर को पता ही नहीं चल रहा है इतना नॉनसेंस मैकेनिक है। मै इसे recommend नहीं करूंगा, क्योंकि मेरा एक्सपीरियंस ठीक काम होने का 30% ही है।। उनलोगों से ज्यादा बेसिक knowledge apne log ke paas hai👍
featured_reviews.review_translated_text: I don't know about bike modification here, but they say yes and then the parts have to be opened and tightened again. I went here to get the crash guard, footrest and saddle stay installed on my bike. They fitted the crash guard properly, but the footrest was tightened so badly and without any logic or knowledge that it made such a loud noise that the bike jolted, that I thought something might have broken. But later I understood from YouTube what they did, they tightened one side nut on the soccer nut which is an external part and tightened another nut on the saree guard so that when the soccer goes down while riding, there is tension between the two and the whole bike gets imbalanced and there is a rattling sound and the parts also get a little bent. When I went to get the saddle stay installed for the second time, without any knowledge, they said yes and opened the parts. Then they tightened it so much that they kept the nut crooked without any effort, which made it crooked, as if the staff was not doing their job and were venting their anger. And when they were supposed to loosen it initially, they did it. He was tightening his grip as if the customer wasn't aware of it. He's such a no-nonsense mechanic. I wouldn't recommend him, as my experience only measures the work 30% of the time. Our people have more basic knowledge than they do.

featured_reviews.name: Kalyan Reddy
featured_reviews.review_text: Got my Honda H'ness CB350 serviced here recently, and overall it was a smooth experience. There were a few things that needed attention, including rust in various places on the bike such as the body, chrome parts and the fuel cap, and they sorted all of that out nicely without overcomplicating things. I also got the bike serviced with an engine oil change, along with a chain replacement (Rolon brass chain), a BMC air filter installation and rear brake pad replacement. What I liked was that they paid attention to the smaller details and did not try to upsell unnecessary stuff. The bike feels noticeably smoother now, and honestly, the quality of servicing here felt better than what I have experienced at the official service center. Good, honest work and pretty professional throughout. Kudos to Raj and his team for the great experience I had. Would highly recommend them!

featured_reviews.name: Upendra singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Here's my honest take.

The guys here are knowledgeable, hard working and perform what they say to the perfection. No cutting corners.

My bike (a vstrom 650 xt) was having issues of stalling when overheating. Could ride only about 17 to 20 kms max and on a good day about 25 kms.

The issue though was pointed out to me by fellow rider as root cause, the work they have done to resolve that issue was superfluous.

In addition to changing the fuel filter which was the issue, these guys worked on my fuel drain (outlet for gas built up in tank).

Side stand sensor was checked and found to be with cut wires by them and was resolved as it was contributing to stalling of the bike.

The brake servicing was done nicely that the hardwork these people was outstanding. Before this visit I never knew that this is how much can be done behind brake pads, brake caplipers and cylinders. I believe me I have seen many authorised as well as 3rd party service centers which don't do anything at all.

Chain cleaning for other service centers is just a couple of sprays here and there against which they charge you the same amount as that of entire cans of cleaner and lube. But for these guys it was scrubbing, cleaning, lubricating, chain alignment and much more of such things to make sure the chain looks like new.

I would say say that they are charging on the lower side but what they have charged me is worth every penny and is the best money I have spent in my 14 years of riding.

featured_reviews.name: Ameya More
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wow, you guys absolutely nailed the restoration of my old bike! It's a 2013 Royal Enfield Thunderbird 350 model, and I brought it in with the hope it could be salvaged, but you've truly exceeded all expectations. It looks and feels like it just rolled off the factory floor, if not better. I'm genuinely blown away by the attention to detail and the quality of the work. Seriously, it's in "better than showroom" condition now. I couldn't be happier with the result. You've brought this classic machine back to life in the most spectacular way. A huge thank you for such an incredible job!

Just wanted to give a shout-out to the amazing work done on my 2022 Triumph Street Triple RS as well! They totally nailed the coolant change and seriously upped the heat management game. My ride feels so much better now, and I'm genuinely thrilled with the results. It's so important to have a bike that runs cool, especially on those longer journeys and our stop go traffic.I was worried about it before, but now I have peace of mind. Seriously impressed with their skills and attention to detail. Definitely recommend their services if you're looking to get your bike running at its best. Big thanks to the team for their fantastic work!

Raj (the founder) and hia team of great professionals are extremely knowledgeable and have built and maintained an array of imported sports/cruiser bikes in this workshop of theirs.
We the owners of such bikes dontind spending an extra penny if we are getting the worth of it, but this place saves ur extra penny as well along with delivering a great outcome.
They will give you realistic timelines and most of all will not over commit and under deliver.
I would suggest them to anyone looking for a professional care hub for their high end bike.
Way to go Team Dynamic Racing.... Cheers.

featured_reviews.name: Jeyavignesh R
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve done two major services for my Triumph Street Twin 900 at Dynamic Racing Concept — one after purchasing the bike and one after completing a 3000 km Jaisalmer ride.
Both experiences were very positive.

The team went beyond basic service: they cleaned the throttle body thoroughly, changed engine oil, oil filter, and brake pads, and fixed my repeatedly breaking stock indicators by installing a stronger modified solution.

After every service, the bike genuinely felt fresh and more responsive. Throttle response improved, vibrations reduced, and overall ride quality became smoother.
They clearly know how to handle Triumph 900 twins and their work has been consistent.

Good place for service, post-ride maintenance, and small repairs. Will continue servicing my bike here.

Thanks to Raj & his Team.

featured_reviews.name: Dishanth Kembhavi
featured_reviews.review_text: Pawan's expertise and knowledge of bike servicing is incomparable. I've been getting my bike serviced from him for over 3 years now, and each time, after servicing, my bike feels like it's brand new. It is because of his timely and precise work, that I've been able to ride my bike without any troubles for long distances over extended time periods. Also, his shop is easy to find - off WEH, a few 100 metres between SGNP and Dahisar Checknaka. Anyone looking to get their bike serviced thoroughly should visit him.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Pawan is an extremely talented and dedicated person. He recently assembled and performed the initial setup of a Di2 groupset on my bike, helped with sourcing a bottom bracket, tools and a handlebar as well.

Thanks to him for his expertise!

featured_reviews.name: Dr. Aditya Banerjee
featured_reviews.review_text: I have a Trek Marlin 5 MTB. The bike was kept in my parking for months and Pawan at Biketuner Labs made it as good as new. Very happy with my bike's performance and I am back to riding. If you have a bike which you care about and love riding, this is the place where you can expect a professional approach to bike restoration. Great job Biketuner lab.

featured_reviews.name: Dillon Salian
featured_reviews.review_text: Having been servicing my bike from Pawan for more than 3 years now n never have i had any issue with it... Pawan's knowledge n skill set for bike maintenance n parts is impeccable.. I would highly recommend visiting him for bicycle service or any bicycle related queries.. They even have a variety of bicycle products which u can check n out n purchase from d shop

featured_reviews.name: Rohan Bhattacharya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pawan, bro you are a gem. The way you treat your people shows how mature and humble you are. Your technical skills are obviously great as others mentioned but your customer centric attitude will take you places.

Guys, he not only assembled my bike, he made sure I take it home safe and sound. Since, I was not planning to ride it there and then due to Ganesha festival, I had called a small truck. He went above and beyond and helped me put it in safely.

In cycling community, my opinion is let's uplift each other and ride along. People like Pawan are passionate and caring in what they do and that has touched me.

Thank you so much Pawan, once again. See you soon with some servicing of my bike 😁🚲💪

featured_reviews.name: Omkar Sandhane
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited **Biketuner.lab** for my road bicycle and had an excellent experience. The service was top-notch, with Mr. Pawan being particularly helpful and knowledgeable. He guided me through the entire process with great patience. The prices were also quite reasonable, making it a fantastic value for the quality of work done. Highly recommended for anyone looking to get their bike tuned or serviced!

featured_reviews.name: Saurabh Khare
featured_reviews.review_text: Pawan is a highly professional individual. He's honest and dedicated towards his craft which distinguishes his place from other "bicycle repair shops". Highly recommended for all your bicycle woes...👍
